name: HyperASHS-PMC
shortdesc: Hippocampal and MTL subfield segmentation in high-res T2-MRI using HyperASHS with PMC 3T unified atlas
longdesc: Automatic segmentation of MTL subregions and hippocampal subfields in high-resolution T2-weighted 3 Tesla MRI scans, using the 2026 unified atlas from the Penn Memory Center. The original ASHS PMC atlas (Yushkevich et al., 2015) has been extended to incorporate anterior MTL cortex and amygdala (Sadeghpour et al., 2025) and is consistent with the T1-only HyperASHS-PMC-T1 atlas.

tags.name: T2-MRI
tags.hint: A high-resolution (e.g., 0.4x0.4x2.0mm^3) T2-weighted MRI scan with oblique coronal orientation parallel to hippocampal main axis. This scan must be the main image in the workspace.

tags.name: T1-MRI
tags.hint: Roughtly isotropic (e.g., 1x1x1mm^3) T1-weighted MRI scan of the whole brain.
